profile.name: Prateek Parihar

projects.name: AI CV Assistant
projects.summary: AI-powered resume optimization assistant for ATS compatibility, rewrite guidance, and tailored cover letter generation.

projects.solution: Built an AI-driven resume scoring and optimization tool that evaluates CV alignment, highlights skill gaps, and generates role-tailored cover letters.
projects.architecture: User Resume Input -> Prompt Router Engine -> LLM Evaluation Layer -> ATS Scoring Engine -> Recommendation & Cover Letter Builder
projects.key_results: Automates resume alignment evaluation and produces tailored application materials in seconds.

projects.name: AI Business Intelligence Copilot
projects.summary: Analytics platform that converts raw uploaded datasets into executive business insights, dashboard recommendations, and DAX/SQL queries.
projects.problem: Non-technical business leaders struggle to quickly extract structured stories and actionable KPI drivers from complex tabular data.
projects.solution: Created an AI-assisted analytics copilot that ingests raw business datasets, performs automated data profiling, and outputs structured insight summaries and visual chart recommendations.
projects.architecture: Data Upload -> SQL/Pandas Processing -> LLM Insight Engine -> Power BI Layout Mapper -> Executive Report
projects.key_results: Drastically reduces time-to-insight for operational dataset exploration.

projects.name: Master's Thesis: Fuel Prices and EV Demand in New Zealand
projects.summary: BSNS9000 Industry Research Project examining how fuel prices, policy settings, and consumer behavior drive electric vehicle adoption in NZ.
projects.problem: Understanding whether market fuel price pressure alone drives EV adoption or if government policy stability and total cost of ownership (TCO) perceptions play a larger role.
projects.solution: Executed a multi-method research design blending 15-year macroeconomic panel data, a primary consumer survey, econometric modeling, and a 3-month real-world EV ownership trial.
methodology: 15-Year International Panel Data Analysis (2010-2024 across NZ, Norway, China, US)
Primary Consumer Survey with 103 NZ respondents
3-Month Real-World EV Ownership Trial using a 2011 Nissan Leaf
Econometric Modeling using Elasticity Analysis, Granger Causality, and ARIMA Time-Series Forecasting
projects.key_results: Proved that policy uncertainty creates immediate adoption drops despite high fuel prices, and designed a revenue-neutral 7-step policy plan for sustainable EV transition.

projects.name: AI-Powered Retail Demand Forecasting System
projects.summary: Forecast-led planning workflow designed to reduce inventory waste and improve replenishment decision confidence.
projects.problem: Traditional static ordering caused overstocking in slow-moving categories and stockouts during peak demand periods.
projects.solution: Implemented time-series demand forecasting using Prophet and Python to generate dynamic reorder point recommendations.
projects.key_results: Identified potential 15% reduction in inventory waste and stockout frequency.

projects.name: Gilmours Workflow Analysis and Process Redesign
projects.summary: Workflow mapping and delay diagnosis project delivering actionable recommendations to improve delivery reliability.
projects.problem: Operational bottlenecks and dispatch delays led to customer satisfaction penalties in wholesale delivery.
projects.solution: Conducted end-to-end workflow mapping, driver interviews, and root cause delay analysis to redesign loading and dispatch sequences.
projects.key_results: Identified dispatch bottleneck solutions projected to reduce delivery delays by 20%.

projects.name: Synlait Milk Supply Chain Optimisation
projects.summary: Supply chain optimization strategy leveraging design-thinking diagnostics and sustainability-linked KPI recommendations.
projects.problem: Complex dairy supply chain variables created vulnerability to input volatility and emissions tracking gaps.
projects.solution: Applied design-thinking diagnostics to model supplier-to-plant logistics and recommend sustainable performance KPIs.
projects.key_results: Delivered executive roadmap for logistics resilience and sustainability reporting.

projects.name: Generative AI Business Process Automation

projects.problem: Weekly operational reporting required hours of manual data extraction, formatting, and commentary writing.
projects.solution: Created an automated LLM workflow (Claude & OpenAI APIs) that pulls weekly metric summaries, generates executive draft commentaries, and flags anomalies.
projects.key_results: Achieved a 70% reduction in manual reporting compilation time.

projects.name: Genesis Energy Supply Chain Analysis

projects.solution: Evaluated supply chain dependencies, risk exposure, and strategic options for fuel security and carbon reduction.
projects.key_results: Produced strategic risk mitigation matrix for energy transition planning.
